query:
SELECT id, asaas_payment_id, asaas_customer_name, asaas_customer_email, value, due_date, status, classified, classified_at, linked_charge_id
FROM unclassified_charges
WHERE (asaas_customer_name LIKE '%Ryan%' OR asaas_customer_email LIKE '%limiransafg%')
   OR (value = 700.00 AND due_date LIKE '2026-03-16%')
ORDER BY due_date DESC
LIMIT 10;
